_comment: Which reply leads to which line. The one thing about an NPC the client has never held.
The client ships every line an NPC can say and every reply it can be given, and nowhere does
it say which goes with which - measured across all 6,467 of them. That pairing has always
lived on Ankama's server, so it cannot be extracted or measured. It has to be decided, and
this is where the decision goes.
npc         the NPC's id
map         0 for wherever it stands; a map id to say something different there
opening     which line it starts on; the first one when left out
lines       one per thing it says, each with what can be said back
next        the line that reply leads to; left out, the conversation ends
And what a reply is FOR, which is what stops a conversation offering everything at once:
startsQuest  this reply hands that quest over. Not the same as `quest`: this one is how a
quest begins, so it is offered to somebody who has NOT got it.
quest        only offered while that quest is under way.
step         and only while it is on that step.
afterQuest   only offered once the quest is finished.
Where the conversation opens, when it is not always the same line:
openings     tried in order, the first that holds wins; none, and `opening`. Each has a
`message` or a `byBreed` table (breed id to message) and any of: `before`
(quest neither started nor finished), `quest` (under way), `step` (and on that
step), `objective` (and that objective done), `after` (quest finished),
`criterion` (the character meets it, in the client's language: «Ps=0»).
pushes       a line the NPC opens by itself, with no click, once a step of a quest ends:
`afterStep` and a `message` or `byBreed`. The tutorial's voice does it.
params       what a reply shows beside it, as effects: a number, or an array whose first
number is the effect and the rest what it names, [34, 2511] for «starts quest
{ "npc": 1088, "map": 0, "opening": 3312, "lines": [
{ "message": 6047, "choices": [ { "reply": 7846 } ] } ] }
A line with no replies is fine now: the client draws its own Leave button and the X closes the
window, because the server answers the kla it sends. It did not before, which is why an NPC
with nothing to say back used to trap you in the conversation.
WHERE THESE COME FROM. The ids are the client's own. The wiring - which reply leads where -
is read off the walkthroughs at dofuspourlesnoobs, which write the reply options out in
French, and matched back to ids with tools/dialogue_from_guide.py. Inside one NPC the text
identifies its lines 98.3% of the time, and the reply ids do not have to be Ankama's: the
server sends the ids and the client sends back what it was given, so any id with the right
text works as long as the tree agrees with itself.
mutation      the reply gives this mutation item after its teleport (the Orbalantir's).
endsMutation  the reply takes the player's mutation away after its teleport.

Director Grunob in his office, the Akademia's last room, his poor cat Dagoberto all ruffled, go before he gets really angry (50453; «Abandonar la Akademia» leaves, dungeon_exits.json). «De joyeux petits arbres» (2455): «Gob Ross sends his regards» (18535), little Gob Ross who drew while the others fought with snot (50454), «hard to imagine goblins studying in peace», too many pupils, a teacher or two to hire (50455), «his brush», the forbidden wardrobe where he keeps what he confiscates (50456: «Ir a inspeccionar el armuario», the wardrobe 524400 gives the brush, 18541), he remembered putting it there (50457: «Gracias por el pincel», 18554, or «Meter el pincel en tu bolsa e irte de aquí»).

Patalenta: the koalaks' mountain was never mapped properly, a description of a few places from a curious young adventurer (3322: «Visite non guidée», 146, «Te ayudaré»); young and vigorous, it will not take long (3325, the five places discovered, 545-549, the hello ends it, 550); the new world map on the toilet wall (3326).

Koka Dekolak, the manager of a sinking firm who wants to diversify, at the koalaks' village (12885). Three quests of a day each: «Course polaire» (149, «dragoturkey resources», the list in the journal, dragoturkeys round the village, 12886), «Épicerie fine» (148, «plants of the region», the koalaks' bags full of them, 12887), «Charger la mule» (150, «koalak resources», the kalyptus wood and the Wild Canyon, 12888); each handed over with its own «Darle...» (12889-12891: enough for now, come back tomorrow).

Maskara the alchemist in Astrub [6,-21]: for alchemists the koalaks' mountain is a paradise, some of its flowers, but careful (3327). «Des fleurs épineuses» (147), a daily quest of Dofus pour les noobs for alchemists above level 79: «Aceptar ayudar a Maskara», the wild orchids grow in the dragoturkeys' territory, look for freyesque orchids (11403); the god Sadida keeps you from picking them, or are you dodging? (3328: the twenty wild orchids 13153 handed over on the hello, 551); thanks for the harvest, come back a little later (3329, the quest again the next day).

Esmeralda at [-20,10]: may Rushu burn what is left of your conscience, you attacked her young defenceless sadidas (3146). «Le déguisement du Koalak» (229): «sorry», remorse at last, but a little favour (4073: «Escuchar lo que espera de ti», 229), a koalak disguise, a whole koalak set in good condition and she may forgive (4074: «Dar el set koalak», the seven pieces 8003-8009 handed over, 933-939).

Captain Kradoc (Guarrok) on Sufokia's quay [15,28]: to the end of the world, a desert island with no kanniboulas (4123). «Le nouveau monde» (231) of Dofus pour les noobs: «Aceptar», just accepting is not enough, a dangerous adventure (4124), stubborn, a long voyage, we shall have to protect ourselves (4125: «Aceptar la misión»), the materials? (4158: «Darle los objetos», two elite chafer misericords, a big cannonball, a foufayteur ear, sesame oil, 941-944), at last, the ammunition and his breakfast (4126). The voyage (4127: «Viajar a la isla», or «Acompañar a un amigo al que le asustan los piratas»): pirates! (4128: «Continuar con la conversación», the fight against the rachitic boomba, nakunbra and canon dorf, and the ship runs aground on the castaways' island). Once Otomai is reached, so you want to go back? (4159: to the isle of Otomai, or to the castaways' island).

Kradoc run aground on the castaways' island [-43,2]. «L'île des naufragés» (232): the wrong place, his digestion again (4130), pirates and kokokos, raised by a kokoko tribe (4131), thirsty and hungry, wood, tools, food (4132: «Aceptar y traerle el material»), the materials? (4158: «Darle los materiales», a kokoko trunk, the Flib's cursed casket, a kokopaille, a nodkoko slice, 945-948), unbelievable, a bit more effort (4133: «Continuar el viaje»), still damaged but sailing, or wait here a few days (4134: «Irse de Isla de los Náufragos», to Otomai).
Kradoc on Otomai's quay [-44,21]: a short and rather quiet trip after all, his reflexes intact (4135: «Viajar a Sufokia»).

Professor Fornasol, who heals the island's wounded creatures since he lost his seven balls, and finishes them off sometimes (4138). «La Potion Bulbique» (234): «I'm free», the coralators to heal (4139: «Acepto el trabajo»), the bulbic potion? (4140: «Entregar la pócima», 8913, 950), he will try not to drink it all himself (4142); the coralators can use what is left of their brains (4141).

Polka Merer, the assistant of Otomai in charge of the paddocks (4143). «Polka Merer a besoin de vous» (235): dragoturkey machines slightly modified (4144: «Aceptar la misión»), the breeding fuels? (4145: «Ten, los carburantes de cría», 951-955), all she needs (4147), the creatures bred for days (4146).

Paulette Pain-bèche, one of the best bakers of the World of Twelve (4148). «Paulette Pain-bèche la boulangère» (236): cereal flours for the island's creatures (4149), Javier the Baker's famous flour, too long to make (4150: «Aceptar la misión»), all the cereals? (4151: «Toma los cereales», 956-965), mixed and nobody will notice (4152); her genius idea (4153).

Flip Flap, scaeroplane pilot, named after the sound of a scarafly's wings in free fall (4174). «Un autre moyen de transport» (240): years dreaming of riding dragoturkeys (4175: «Aceptar la misión»), the two dragoturkeys? (4176: «Ten, los dos dragopavos», 975, 976), his breeding at last, the ginger on even days, the almond on odd days (4177). Once his quest is done he flies to the island's other scaeroplanes whose pilots have granted landing, their own quests done (4172: «¿Hacia qué Escareopuerto quieres que te lleve?»).

Spitte Fayeur, the scaeroplane pilot of the canopy village [-54,19]: do not laugh at her name (4168). «Scaéroplane à très grande vitesse» (239) of Dofus pour les noobs: the fastest tame scaraflies, an improved outfit (4169: «Acepto la proposición»), the items? (4170: «Dar los objetos», the improved wooden wings and helmet, 973, 974), faster flights (4171). Once his quest is done he flies to the island's other scaeroplanes whose pilots have granted landing, their own quests done (4172: «¿Hacia qué Escareopuerto quieres que te lleve?»).

Kito, the coastal village's pilot [-49,14], of twelve generations of scaeroplane pilots and a few accidents (4183). «La vengeance du Kito» (242) of Dofus pour les noobs: the pirates of Otomai's ark shoot at him (4184: «Acepto la proposición», a sparo, a barbroussa and a flib to beat, 1008-1010), well, did you smash the pirates? (4185). Once his quest is done he flies to the island's other scaeroplanes whose pilots have granted landing, their own quests done (4172: «¿Hacia qué Escareopuerto quieres que te lleve?»).

Peggy la Porkass [-57,4]: the hateful Black and Pink Knight gave her that nickname, she wants revenge (4187: «La vengeance de Peggy la Porkass», 243, the knight beaten at [-58,-5], 1011), have you faced him? (4188: «Pronto lo haré»). Once his quest is done he flies to the island's other scaeroplanes whose pilots have granted landing, their own quests done (4172: «¿Hacia qué Escareopuerto quieres que te lleve?»).

Crocodaille Dandi on Otomai's plains, who sews naughty underwear of crocodaille scales and always wanted the island to be a park (4178). «Les Chasses de Crocodaille Dandi» (241): hunts that give adventurers a purpose and thin the island's creatures (4179: «Participar a la cacería», the creatures of each step beaten anywhere), not finished yet, hurry (4180); one of the bravest adventurers he knows (4181).

The Black and Pink Knight on the bridge of the bottomless peat bog [-58,-5]: nobody crosses without a duel (60402). «Le chevalier noir et rose» (233) of Dofus pour les noobs: «accept the challenge», the fight (1093: 949, and Peggy la Porkass's revenge with it, 1011); «tell me about you», the passage the goddess entrusted to him (60403), «what is a pandawa doing here?», fight or not? (60404: a monomaniac, the fight), «I mean to cross», en garde (60405: «Desenvainar el arma»); beaten, worthy to cross (4137).

The guardian of the bridge of death at the coral beach [-56,0]: answer right or die (4114). «Le gardien du pont de la mort» (230) of Dofus pour les noobs, «Donner les bonnes réponses vous permettra de valider la quête. En donner une seule mauvaise lancera le combat contre le gardien»: the favourite colour, any but «another colour» (4115); the sex of your parents' child who is neither brother nor sister, the character's own (4116, PS); can you cross your arms, yes if the attitude is known (4117, emote 14); the morito corals a perfect boufbelt would let you carry, 100, 200, 400 or 600 by the free pods (4118, Pw); the colour of Henry Kard's white dragoturkey (4120), «a normal corbac or an ugly little one?» (4119), he does not know (4121), «wait, I call a friend», you beat him at his own game (4122: «Cruzar el puente», 940, over to the bottomless peat bog). Every wrong answer is his fight; beaten, he can be asked again.

Doctor Niet on the grassy plains [-55,4]: his son Juan, his adored little wabbit, is stuck in that abandoned laboratory and the creatures there frighten him too much (4154). «Le fils caché» (237) of Dofus pour les noobs, «Parlez à Docteur Nauch qui a perdu son fils dans le laboratoire envahi de créatures»: «Entrar en el laboratorio» into its First Room, have you found my little wabbit? (4155: back in, while Juan is still to be found; once he is, the hello does 970), thanks to you he will call him «mi pequeño jalatín» from now on (4156); «vous pouvez refaire ce mini-donjon pour aider un amis ou tout seul contre un fragment de cerveau poli»: «Visitar el laboratorio», sure? not without a polished brain fragment (4302: «Darle el fragmento de cerebro pulío y entrar», 8762).

Juan Niet, hidden in the laboratory's Exit room: he can't stand his father calling him «Mi Wabbit», could you explain it to him? (4157: «Aceptar y salir del laboratorio», 969, out on the plains); for whoever comes back, do you want to leave? (24588: «Salir.», DungeonExitRooms).

Doctor Morros on the branches of the Hakam tree [-52,16]: his wife is gone, he can take you where he saw her last (4160). «La femme perdue» (238) of Dofus pour les noobs: «Seguir al doctor Morros para ayudarle» into the Floribund Clearing, she was fleeing that way, the creatures there first (4161: back in, while she is still to be found), did you find her? (4165: «Explicarle por qué se fugó su mujer», 972), he has to learn to win her over himself (4166); rejuvenated (4167), «Volver a la Oscura Jungla para ayudar a un amigo», sure? not without a pe-leon tooth chalice (4303: «Dar un cáliz de diente pe-león», 8781), to the Dark Jungle beside the tree [-51,16].

Juana Morros, run away into the Floribund Clearing: her husband cares more for his monsters than for her (4162), Bonta, the flame of the first days (4163), she ran so that he would react, explain it to him (4164: «Acepto.», 971, back to him on the branches).

Ganymed by the temple's book, where 1631's last objective (9740) has the character talk to him: before the book, his word on the Dofus and the hint to it (60427, 60428); once it is read, 57151 «Ha llegado el momento de que comiences tu gran viaje» with «Dirigirte a la salida del Templo Celeste» («reparlez à Ganymède qui vous conseille de quitter le temple direction Incarnam», Dofus pour les noobs); afterwards, his farewell 57154. «Dirigirte a la salida del Templo Celeste» is what completes 9740 and ends the quest, so the hello does not skip the line.

Andrée Inkarnay by the Celestial Temple's gates. «Réponses à tout» of Dofus pour les noobs: «Répondre qu'il n'est de toute façon pas possible de faire marche arrière» (52780), the gods love to watch their disciples (52781), «Dire qu'à la réflexion, votre puissance tutélaire ne vous correspond pas», take this philtre, only for novices (52782: «Prendre le philtre», 28361, «tant que vous êtes de niveau 20 ou moins»); not drunk yet? (52783); no longer a novice (52784). Once 1631 is done, 3.6's own line 60429 with «L'ignorer et sortir du Temple.», out to the foot of the steps in Incarnam, and 60430 for whoever is past level 20.

Captain Tadora, Bonta's recruiter by the zaap [-31,-56]: «L'appel de la cité blanche» (2429). Dofus pour les noobs: a Brakmarian shows his badge and she wants him out «Se tenir prêt à l'affronter», a Bontarian shows his and she wants to measure him «Accepter avec un plaisir non dissimulé», a neutral asks how to join and has to beat her first; «Dans tous les cas, le même combat se lance» (content/fights/npc_fights.json). «Une fois le combat terminé, reparlez à la Capitaine ... pour terminer la quête», except a neutral, who still has to see Amayiro [-32,-57]: the sworn's last reply does both talks (18444, 18445), the neutral's only hers. Which reply leads to which line is read off their texts; INFERRED: «Sacar pecho» beside «¿Qué te ha parecido mi actuación?» for her own side, on her greeting once the duel is won.

Captain Cryba, Brakmar's recruiter by the zaap [-26,37]: «L'appel de la cité sombre» (2430), the mirror of Tadora's. Dofus pour les noobs: the same three greetings by side, «Dans tous les cas, le même combat se lance», and the quest ends talking to her again, a neutral still having to see Oto Mustam [-25,33]. The sworn's «Dejarla trabajar e ir a saludar a Oto Mustam» and «Decidir ir a burlarte de Oto Mustam» do both talks (18440, 18441). INFERRED: «Sacar pecho» beside «¿Qué te ha parecido mi actuación?» for her own side.

Amayiro, chief of Bonta's militia [-32,-57]. His template's greetings: «¡Dad la alerta! ¡Un demonio ha entrado en Bonta!» for a Brakmarian, with «Aprovechar el tumulto para huir.», and «Cuando se trata de defender los valores de Bonta...» for the rest. Seeing him is the neutral's last step of 2429 (18445, a hello). His militia quests (55 onwards) are not written yet.

Oto Mustam, Brakmar's chief [-25,33]. His template's greetings: «¿Un sirviente del bien en Brakmar? ¡Guardias!» for a Bontarian, with «Huir para no sufrir la ira de Oto Mustam.», «Vaya, vaya: un alma neutra en este lugar» for a neutral and «Lo bueno de liderar una ciudad como Brakmar...» for his own. Seeing him is the neutral's last step of 2430 (18441, a hello). His militia quests are not written yet.

The sharp-eared kitchen boy of Bonta's palace [-36,-60], who gives «Cuisine raffinée» (2431): Dofus pour les noobs, he hears noises from the garbage chute and nobody believes him; the step's own line is his «¡Ah, no sabes la alegría que me das! ... bajar por el colector de basura». Once the chef has said no (18354), «Mencionar a Ramy»: a rat is fine by him, prove to the chef the rat can cook, and ask the others what dish. Which reply leads to which line is read off their texts.

The kitchen's cook (Commis de cuisine): the chef comes from Amakna's countryside, summer vegetables and spices, «unas cebollas y unas berenjenas con una bolsita de especias». Either helper's advice does «Pídele consejo a los ayudantes» (18355); INFERRED, the quest's own list of ingredients follows.
The kitchen's she-cook (Commise de cuisine): sweet and salty, ripe cheese with kola sugar from Moon. Either helper's advice does 18355 (see the cook's tree).

Chef Tonego in the palace's kitchen. Dofus pour les noobs: short of hands because he only wants the best, and a rat, never (18354 with «Pensar si hay alguna forma de hacerle cambiar de opinión»). With the rata tuy he still refuses, «Soudain Ramy sort de sa cachette» and pleads (thenNpc, thenLine), the chef tastes, weeps, and hires him: «Reprimir una sonrisa» ends the quest (18364) and takes the dish. The order of his lines is read off their texts.

Ramy in Bonta's sewers [-34,-59], where the garbage chute drops you: «No sabía que los doceros estuvieran en el menú de la nobleza bontariana». Dofus pour les noobs: he is the noise, he only wants to cook with real food, you offer to talk to the chef (18353), and «Buscar una forma de subir a la superficie» takes you back up to the kitchen. Later the six ingredients (18356-18361) and «Seguirlo» to the White Rat's pantry.

Ramy in the White Rat's pantry [-34,-59], cooking. Dofus pour les noobs: «Demander quoi faire», check the pot on the stove (element 523818), «Dire que la cuisson est parfaite», grate the cheese on the poor kitchen table (523817) and the mice come (objectives.json, 18363). After the fight he adds the cheese, you taste the rata tuy and take it to the chef (26103), Ramy hiding in the conduits.

Ramy in the palace's kitchen: out of his hiding place when the chef refuses the rata tuy («Oir a Ramy salir de su escondite»), «¡Usted era mi ídolo!», and «Girarte hacia el chef» gives the word back to Tonego, who tastes it. Hired, he stays (spawns.json).

Dexter Minador, the rat-catcher from Kuatropatas at Brakmar's Marmite [-23,37], who gives «Fait comme un rat» (2432): Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «En savoir plus» and he sends you to check his traps in the sewers. Back with all seven checked (18390-18397), he suspects his assistant Dante (18398); with Dante freed, «résumez lui toute la situation» ends it (18405). Which reply leads to which line is read off their texts.

Raty Opatio, the gossip of Brakmar's sewers [-24,38]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «interroger Norat Go au sujet d'un certain Stanis Ast», who saw the Black Rat drag a Brakmarian into her Moumousetrap. Asking about Dante does «Investiga la desaparición de Dante Hallu» (18399).

Dante Hallu, Dexter's assistant, behind bars in the Third Room of the Black Rat's Moumousetrap: Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «parlez à Stanis Ast enfermé derrière des barreaux qui jure être innocent»; promising to bring the Black Rat round does «Encuentra a Dante Hallu en la Raratonera» (18400).

The Black Rat in her Moumousetrap's last room, once beaten (18401): Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «Lui parler de Stanis et demander sa libération», she frees him only for a strong Brakmarian to play with (18403); «Lui présenter la brâkmarienne» hands the militiawoman over (18404, the follower item 26166) and sends you out. «Salir de la Raratonera» takes you back to her door [-28,37].

The bored militiawoman of Brakmar [-28,33]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «Proposer lui donc de consacrer son temps au divertissement du Rat Noir», and she asks for a duel to warm up (content/fights/npc_fights.json, «il s'effectue seul»). Beaten, she follows you: her own loot is the follower 26166, with the client's criterion «Qo>18403&Qo<18404&PO!26166».
The militiawoman once handed over, in the Black Rat's last room: «Desde que estoy aquí, la vida es completamente diferente... la Rata Negra es bastante entrañable».

Rata Plan at the Moumousetrap's door [-28,37]: besides the key and the keyring (DungeonDoor), Dofus pour les noobs, «Fait comme un rat», «parlez à Rat Pido pour « Se rendre auprès du Rat Noir en compagnie de la brâkmarienne »», straight to her room. «No.» closes it.

Pyer Matiz, the collector of the cosmetics market of Bonta [-35,-60], who gives «Le pacte des profondeurs» (2433): Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», his men sent into the sewers for garriglifos are not coming back. «Resumirle los hechos» ends it (18456). Which reply leads to which line is read off their texts.

A garriglifo, the rock carving Pyer is after: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «dès l'entrée sur la map [-31,-57] des égouts parlez à la Calligriffes sur le mur», with signs of a struggle and no fight. Its three «Inspeccionar los alrededores» are one per search zone, in the objectives' order.

A garriglifo, the rock carving Pyer is after: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «descendez les égouts jusqu'en [-31,-55] et parlez à la Calligriffes sur le pilier»: rats attack (content/fights/npc_fights.json). Its three «Inspeccionar los alrededores» are one per search zone, in the objectives' order.

A garriglifo, the rock carving Pyer is after: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «allez sur la gauche jusqu'en [-33,-54] pour inspecter une troisième Calligriphes sur le pilier à droite de la pièce», and the rats attack again. Its three «Inspeccionar los alrededores» are one per search zone, in the objectives' order.

The White Rat's envoy at the third search zone [-33,-54]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «Une fois le combat terminé, parlez à l'Envoyée du Rat Blanc», who blames the surface for breaking the pact of the depths signed with the intendant (18449).

Danathor, Bonta's intendant, in the palace room right of the throne room [-36,-60]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», he signed the pact of the depths and sends you to Captain Tymo for presents (18450); after Tymo's ambush, «Mencionar la emboscada» and he blames Tymo alone (18455).

Captain Tymo napping in the militia's dormitories [-32,-57]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «Parlez alors au Capitaine», who lets you take a crate of weapons from the store across the corridor (18451).

Tymo at the meeting point once the White Rat has gone: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «parlez au Capitaine qui vous a suivi jusqu'ici car il a été chargé de vous éliminer»; «Prepararte para el combate» is the fight against him and two corrupt militia (content/fights/npc_fights.json).

The White Rat at the meeting point of the sewers [-33,-57]: Dofus pour les noobs, «Le pacte des profondeurs», «pénétrez dans les égouts en [-33,-57] pour rencontrer le Rat Blanc et lui remettre l'armement» (18453, the crate 26228 taken). «Après que le Rat Blanc soit partit», Tymo steps in and speaks.

The Bontarian in distress of the sewers [-32,-58], robbed by two bandits: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Sur le point de le sauver, un héros avec un heaume fait son apparition et intervient avant vous»: D'Arratagnan speaks next. Level 90, the quest's PL>89.

D'Arratagnan in the sewers [-32,-58]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», he sends the Bontarian away, charges the bandits and gets beaten; «Lever les yeux au ciel et se préparer à combattre» on his line 50175 (the step's own dialogue) starts the quest and the fight beside him (content/fights/npc_fights.json). Won (18420), he praises you, talks of the White Rat and runs west to her Pantry (18421).
D'Arratagnan waiting at the White Rat's Pantry [-34,-59]: «D'Arratagnan te esperará en la entrada».

The White Rat in her Pantry's last room once beaten (18422): «Salir de la mazmorra» takes you back to its door [-34,-59]; Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Lui demander des informations sur son art du combat», then D'Arratagnan has his say and «Écouter Ratagnan demander confirmation au Rat Blanc»: she sends him to the surface with you (18438) and he follows you from then on (the follower 26202). The two hidden items of the quest (26207, 26208) mark who has spoken.

D'Arratagnan in the Pantry's last room, amazed the White Rat lost: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Parlez à Ratagnan étonné d'avoir assisté à la défaite du Rat Blanc», who will not hear of the surface and goes to ask her himself. Lost in a fight before the library, he comes back here («Volver a la biblioteca»).

Vayinklán in Bonta's library [-35,-57]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Parlez à Marcelle Rouste pour en apprendre plus sur l'art de l'escrime bontarienne», the good blades, the year 290 and the heirs on the Promontory of the Skies (18423). Without D'Arratagnan beside you, «Darte cuenta de que D'Arratagnan no está contigo».

Faramis on the Promontory of the Skies [-36,-59]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», the cousin of intendant Danathor, a good blade; a rat has no noble blood, but he tells the other way only after a duel, and takes you somewhere fitter for it (18425). «Volver a la sala de duelo» if you left it first.

Faramis in the palace's training room: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Vous êtes téléporté dans un dojo, reparlez à Faramis « Affronter Faramis »», alone (content/fights/npc_fights.json, 18426); then a rat can become a good blade by serving one noble person. «Salir de la sala» and «Ir a buscar a otro noble» take you back to the promontory. INFERRED room: 222560266, the palace's one closed training hall [-36,-60] no door leads to («Ya tengo un aprendiz en el palacio»).

Hemmy Lady by the fountain [-35,-59], who lost her miaumiau: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», D'Arratagnan promises to find Nieve, «Reparlez à Ratagnan pour qu'il vous suive» (18427); back with the cat found, she takes him as her own good blade and the quest ends (18428).
D'Arratagnan beside Hemmy Lady: «Vamos a ir en busca de Nieve, ¿no?» and he follows you again; out of breath once Nieve has chased him back here, and her good blade for good after the quest.

Nieve, Hemmy Lady's white miaumiau, among the shiny things of the slums [-33,-55]: Dofus pour les noobs, «La Geste de Ratagnan», «Laisser faire Ratagnan», the cat goes for the rat and chases him north, back to the fountain. «Buscar algo para hacer un cebo» after a scratch ends the same way.
